entry.title: 2026 nî tsa̍p--gue̍h
entry.content:
Jī khòng jī lio̍k nî tsa̍p--gue̍h ê gue̍h-tsì.

2026-10-06

  • Uī 《澳門語言學刊》 khuànn-tio̍h tsi̍t-kuá-á lūn-bûn.

    • 倪廣妍、李心敬. 2022.〈語音形式刪除的漢語研究綜述〉。《澳門語言學刊》60: 97-112。

    Tsìn-tsîng khah tsù-sim tī-leh kù-huat, gí-im tsit pōo-hūn án-nuá kái-sueh, lâi kā khuànn--tsi̍t-ē.

    • 李薔薇、伍雅清、袁健. 2026.〈左緣結構的擴展：理論模型與跨語言分析〉。《澳門語言學刊》67: 121-140。

    Tsó-iân kiat-kòo (Left Periphery) ū sî-tsūn guá tiānn īng, m̄-koh guá kám-kak guá bat tio̍h iáu bô kài thàu, tsiânn tsē Tâi-gí kù lóng m̄ tsai-iánn ài án-nuá kiám-giām.

    • 吳童杰. 2025.〈現代漢語並列截省結構的句法分析〉。《澳門語言學刊》66: 44-59。

    Sluicing tsit-hō hiān-siōng guá mā tsiânn iàu-ì, put-lî-kò lí-lūn tsit pōo-hūn guá bat tio̍h iáu bô kóng kài bîng, jî-tshiánn ū kuá Tâi-gí gí-liāu tàu--tshut-lâi ûn-á bô siánn tàu-tah, ài koh ke khuànn--kuá.

    • 衣莉. 2025.〈聲調描寫：數字表達與特徵表達〉。《澳門語言學刊》.66: 96-107。

    Gí-im tsham siann-ūn gián-kiù ê huat-tián khah kú-tn̂g, kut-lōo mā khah tsāi.

    • 張沐舒. 2025.〈潮汕閩南語話題標記「個」的分佈及來源〉。《澳門語言學刊》65: 28-40。

    Tiâu-suànn uē ê kai55-22 tsiânn sim-sik--neh! Lūn-bûn kóng ná-tshiōnn Huâ-gí …的話. Tsit-hō īng-huat Tâi-gí thong-siông īng honnh, m̄-koh honnh sī-m̄-sī ē-tàng tuì-ìng Huâ-gí ê …的話, ē-thang-tit koh thó-lūn.

    • 張連文. 2024.〈最簡框架下並列空位及加標解析〉。《澳門語言學刊》64: 3-24。

    Minimalist ê lūn-bûn sam-put-gōo-sî tio̍h ē khuànn--tio̍h, guá it-ti̍t siōnn-beh the̍h lâi īng khuànn-māi, tān-sī kang-hu liān tio̍h iáu tsiânn phànn, kàu-tann iáu pìnn-bô-báng.

    • 陳寶賢. 2024.〈福建漳平溪南方言反身代詞的連讀變調〉。《澳門語言學刊》63: 65-74。

    Pún-tē lia̍h-tsún kóng Khe-lâm hit-tah ê ka-tī ū liân-suà piàn-tiāu ê tsîng-hîng, m̄-koh lūn-bûn khuànn liáu, kán-ná m̄ sī án-ne-senn. Put-jî-kò in hia ê ka-tī āu-bīn ē-sái tsiap á, tàu ka-tī-á, tsē tio̍h hōo guá khah ì-guā--looh.

    • 鍾華. 2023.〈反預期話語標記「都」的語義語用特徵〉。《澳門語言學刊》62: 40-49。

    Huâ-gí 都 tiàm Tâi-gí ū nn̄g tsióng tuì-ìng: lóng kap to. Lūn-bûn lāi-té kā Huâ-gí 都 thiah tsò 都a / 都b (sīm-tsì, í-king) bô-tik-khak khah-hó kái-sueh Tâi-gí ê tsōng-hóng.

2026-10-05

  • Khuànn-tio̍h mê-nî sann--gue̍h tsiah beh tshut--ê sin-tsheh: Multilingual Empires: Language, Rule, and the Hybrid Imperial Tradition in Ming China (多語帝國：明代的語言、統治與融合型帝國傳統).

2026-10-03

  • 漢語歷史與方言中的複句國際學術研討會 Day 2. Khuànn-tio̍h tsē-tsē tang-lâm-a gí-giân ê gí-liāu, tsiânn tshù-bī:

    • 〈試說東南亞語言的語法化區域〉

2026-10-02

  • 漢語歷史與方言中的複句國際學術研討會 Day 1. Ū thiann-tio̍h iàu-ì ê tsú-tê, sim-sik--kah:

    • 〈談漢語大開大合的極簡性格：一個複句轉單句的演化奇點〉
    • 〈臺灣客語條件類複句關聯詞的意義與用法〉
    • 〈從西北漢語兩個事例談複句和單句的關聯〉
    • 〈臺灣閩南語連詞「結果」的形成〉
    • 〈從古今比較的觀點論現代湘語完成體助詞 KUA 的來歷〉

2026-10-01

  • ICLC-12: 12th International Contrastive Linguistics Conference

  • JK34: 34th Japanese/Korean Linguistics Conference

  • IcoSem5: 5th Iconicity Seminar: Khîng-si̍t guá bô-siánn tsai-iánn tsit ê gián-thó-huē sī leh tshòng-siánn, m̄-koh siōnn-tio̍h í-tsá ū tsi̍t-ê tê-bo̍k leh tsò Phō-khí-bong (Pokemon) Tâi-gí miâ tsham Hân-gí miâ hō-miâ lí-lōo ê pí-kàu, kán-ná ē tâu--tit.

entry.title: 2026 nî káu--gue̍h
entry.content:
Jī khòng jī lio̍k nî káu--gue̍h ê gue̍h-tsì.

2026-09-25

  • 【藝術文化】孫翠鳳、唐美雲接力登台 歌仔戲兩大旗艦製作11月登場.

2026-09-24

  • Kin-nî WAFL20: 20th Workshop on Altaic Formal Linguistics pān tī-leh Tik-kok, ū khai-hòng suànn-tíng huat-piáu. Ǹg-bāng ū tsi̍t-kang guá ē-tàng tâu tsi̍t-nn̄g-phinn-á lūn-bûn, thó-lūn Tâi-gí kiau Hân-gí ê tsing-tsha.

  • Kin-nî LSHK-ARF-2026: 2026 Annual Research Forum of The Linguistic Society of Hong Kong m̄ tsai-iánn ū kuí phinn kù-huat ê lūn-bûn, tsiânn kî-thāi.

2026-09-22

  • Tsa̍h-bí Gē-su̍t-tsiat Day5: Siù-khîm Kua-kio̍k-thuân (秀琴歌劇團), Nâ-tâu-tsí ua̍h-lia̍h Tsiu, a-si (林投姐活捉周阿司).

  • 為看「鍘美」開車南北奔波到凌晨 波蘭碩士也追來台南研究偶戲: Tsit ê tsò bûn-huà gián-kiù ê guā-kok-lâng lí-lōo koh put-lí-á bîng. Guá kám-kak Tsa̍h-bí Gē-su̍t-tsiat i nā tuè ū tio̍h, tsìng-king thàn--tio̍h, bô tiàm Tâi-uân beh tú-tio̍h tsit-hō ki-huē, tsiânn piànn--leh. Nā-tsún kóng i Tâi-gí ē thong, kan-na tsit kuí kang ê hì-tshut, tio̍h tsiânn ū teh thàm-thó--looh.

2026-09-21

  • Tsa̍h-bí Gē-su̍t-tsiat Day4: Tshun-bí Kua-kio̍k-thuân (春美歌劇團), Si-kong sím Hū-sim (施公審負心).

  • 台南鐵路地下化通車倒數 成功國中揮別火車chi-chia聲.

2026-09-20

  • Tsa̍h-bí Gē-su̍t-tsiat Day3: Sun, Khái-lîm Kua-kio̍k-thuân (孫凱琳歌劇團), Pau-kong tsa̍h Tân, Sè-bí (包公鍘陳世美). Tsit-tshut hì sǹg Sun, Khái-lîm Kua-kio̍k-thuân tsìng-sik tshut-tō.

2026-09-19

  • Tsa̍h-bí Gē-su̍t-tsiat Day2: Lô, Jū-tsông Kua-kio̍k-thuân (羅裕誴歌劇團), Hīng-lîm-uàn - Tshing-thian nōo tsám Hū-sim-hàn (杏林怨-青天怒斬負心漢)

  • Khuànn-tio̍h tsi̍t-phinn leh thó-lūn Kheh-gí kù-bué hóo-tīng mn̄g-kù ê lūn-bûn, kán-ná sī kā khuànn tsò disjunction (suán-ti̍k mn̄g-kù) ê kiat-kó, Ôo Suat-îng 胡雪瀅 (2017) kài-sîng mā án-ne siōnn. M̄-koh guá kám-kak kuài-kuài, in-uī nā tú-tio̍h kù-bué mo31, suán-ti̍k mn̄g-kù thong-siông ē tàu--tit.

    Liao, Yi-Ling Irene. 2025. Revisiting Negative Particle Questions in Sixian Hakka. Languages 10(9). 228. https://doi.org/10.3390/languages10090228.

    胡雪瀅. 2017. 《再探臺灣客語的疑問句》.

2026-09-18

  • Tsa̍h-bí Gē-su̍t-tsiat (鍘美藝術節) Day1: Kóo-too Bo̍k-ngóo Hì-thuân (古都木偶戲團), Pau-kong tsám Hū-má (包公斬駙馬).

2026-09-15

  • 這句「川好勢」唱出他的心聲 李四川今發布競選歌曲「勇敢想勇敢做」: tshiònn tsit tiâu kua ê lâng m̄ tsai-iánn kám ū tshiànn Tâi-gí kòo-būn, ū tsi̍t-kuá-á jī ê khionn bô sio tuè.

2026-09-14

  • Tiàm 台灣人才懂？他誤會「蛋糕給你買好了」回家喜提2盒 全網笑翻 bīn-tíng khuànn-tio̍h sim-sik ê gí-liāu. Thâu tsi̍t tsióng kái-tho̍k sī ke-nn̄g-ko kā lí [bé hó--ah]. Tē-jī tsióng sī [[ke-nn̄g-ko hōo lí bé] hó--ah], bué-liu ê hó--ah ū kiàn-gī, bóng tsò ê ì-sù.

    Piàn tiāu ûn-á khuànn-ē-tshut tsit nn̄g-tsióng tsōng-hóng tiàm kù-huat lāi-té sóo tsiàm--ê uī bô sio-siâng, tē-it tsióng bé ū piàn tiāu, tē-jī tsióng bé tha̍k guân tiāu. Khîng-si̍t Huâ-gí mā sio-siâng.

    • 李佳純. 2008.《語言接觸引發的演變──以台灣華語「給」為例》。新竹市：國立清華大學博士論文。

    • 鄭良偉、程俊源. 2009.〈臺語、華語的「使動」、「讓動」kap「自動」句型〉。《台語研究》1.1: 80-107。

    • 張永利. 2013.〈及物輕動詞為分段主要語：鄒語、台灣華語及閩南語的例證〉。《臺灣語文研究》8.1: 93-114。

2026-09-13

  • Mê-nî (2027) GLOW XV: Generative Linguistics in The Old World in Asia XV àn-sǹg pān tī-leh Tâi-su-tāi (臺師大), tsín leh tsio kó, siōnn khuànn ū siánn tê-bo̍k thang tâu--bô?

2026-09-12

  • Windows pán ê Tâi-gí khí-puânn (台語齒盤) īng tio̍h koh put-lí-á lī-piān, hó-sè-á hó-sè. Guá khuànn guá tiān-náu lāi-bīn ê Sìn-bōng-ài Tâi-gí Kheh-gí Su-ji̍p-huat (信望愛台語客語輸入法, FHL Taigi-Hakka IME) tsit-siann hó thang thè-hiu--looh.

2026-09-11

  • Bāng-lōo sûn-tio̍h tsi̍t-kù sim-sik ê Tâi-gí gí-liāu, m̄-tsai ài án-nuá khui-thiah:

    伊嘛是較早保護我有到的（當初曾經保護我的）

    Guá siōnn tsit-kù kiám-tshái sī: I mā-sī khah-tsá pó-hōo guá ū tio̍h--ê. Té-tsân huān-sè senn-tsò: I ū pó-hōo tio̍h guá → I pó-hōo guá ū tio̍h. Tān-sī suá-uī án-nuá suá, guá tio̍h siōnn bô--looh?

    M̄ tsai-iánn tsit-hō kù-hîng tsham khuànn i buē khí kám ū thang pí-kàu?

2026-09-09

  • Tiān-náu ê bô-suànn ku̍t-tshú kài-sîng beh pháinn beh pháinn. Tó-ji̍h sam-put-gōo-sî tio̍h leh pā-kang, tiong-ji̍h hit-lia̍p kún-lûn (滾輪) lìn tio̍h mā bô siánn huán-ìng, guá khuànn ài lâi uānn sin--ê--ah.

    Bāng-lōo sûn-tio̍h tsi̍t-ki ē-tàng tshiong-tiān ê bô-suànn ku̍t-tshú, kán-ná buē-bái, kè-siàu tsi̍t-pah thóng niâ, bô-kóng kài kuì.

  • Kin-nî FOSS-16: The 16th Workshop on Formal Syntax and Semantics (第 16 屆形式句法學暨語意學研討會) pān tī-leh Kim-mn̂g, gī-tîng khuànn-bô Tâi-gí tiônn, nā bô king-huì póo-tsōo, tsuan-kang tsáu tsi̍t-tsuā, guá khuànn sī bē-hô.

2026-09-08

  • Iú-pih ê ba̍k-kiànn hó--ah, theh ba̍k-kiànn sīn-suà pài-thok tiàm-uân kā tíng-pái giām-kng ê kiat-kó siá hōo guá:

    Luī/Pōo-uīTsiànn-luíTò-luí
    Kīn-sī825850
    Luān-sī5050
    Lāu-lâng-ba̍k175175

2026-09-07

  • Sûn-tio̍h tsi̍t-ê sin-ê LuaLaTeX pòo-kíng: Cookie: a modern Beamer Theme.

2026-09-05

  • Tsái-khí thiann Ong, Ka-im (翁佳音) lāu-su ê suànn-tíng ián-káng: Tâi-uân Tsá-kî Kok-tsè Kau-liû-sú (臺灣早期國際交流史), tiőng siāu-kài kuí-pún-á tsheh: Tang-Ìn-tōo Lú-iû Kiàn-bûn (東印度旅遊見聞), 享和三年癸亥漂流臺灣チョプラン島之記.

2026-09-04

  • Kin-á tsá-tǹg khah uànn tsia̍h, pún-té siōnn-kóng tiong-tàu-tǹg bé tsian-kiáu tshìn-tshái tsia̍h tio̍h hó, bô siōnn-tio̍h kóng tsian-kiáu-tiàm pōo-pîn tah tsi̍t-tionn kong-pò, kóng uì tsa̋ng khai-sí hioh la̍k-kang, tsí-hó phīnn-á bong-bong--leh khì pau iônn-bah piān-tong.

  • Khuànn-tio̍h Morphology as Syntax 5 teh tsio-kó ê siau-sit, lāi-bīn ū tsi̍t-kuá khah sin ê lūn-bûn thang tsham-khó.

    • Collins, Chris & Richard S. Kayne. 2023. Towards a Theory of Morphology as Syntax. Studies in Chinese Linguistics 44. 1–32. https://doi.org/10.2478/scl-2023-0001.

    • Zyman, Erik. 2026. On the Syntactic Autonomy of Theme Vowels. Journal of Linguistics 1–33. https://doi.org/10.1017/S002222672610111X.

    • Koopman, Hilda. 2005. Korean (and Japanese) Morphology from a Syntactic Perspective. Linguistic Inquiry 36(4). 601–633. https://doi.org/10.1162/002438905774464359.

  • Guá ū tsi̍t-hù iú-pih--ê ba̍k-kiànn, uì sió-ha̍k kuà kàu tann, í-king kuí-nā tsa̍p-tang--looh, tíng-bīn lóng sian--liáu-liáu. Siōnn-kóng ài hōo thè-hiu--ah. Tîng-phuè tsi̍t-hù lâi tsò iú-pih. Siōnn-buē-kàu giām-kng ê sî-tsūn, tsiah huat-kak kóng guá ê kīn-sī tōo-sòo iū-koh tsing-ka--ah. Nn̄g-luí bô sio-siāng, tsha-put-to uá peh-káu-pah, luān-sī khah khing, gōo-tsa̍p tōo niâ, á-nā lāu-lâng-ba̍k sī tsha-put-to nn̄g-pah.

2026-09-03

  • Mê-nî la̍k--gue̍h The 34th Annual Meeting of the Austronesian Formal Linguistics Association (AFLA-34) àn-sǹg tiàm Tiong-iong Gián-kiú-īnn pān, tiah-iàu mê-nî it-gue̍h tsa̍p-gōo tsìn-tsîng kià, m̄-tsai kám ài thàn tsit-hō ki-huē khì thiann Guân-tsū-bîn-gí Gí-giân Tiau-tsa Gián-kiú (Studies in Survey of Austronesian Languages)? Tsit-mn̂g khò kán-ná m̄-bat khui--kuè, nā bô khì thiann, āu-tsuā kiám-tshái bô ki-huē.

    M̄-koh nā-beh tâu AFLA-34, tsín ū tsi̍t-ê būn-tê sī: sui-bóng guá Lâm-tó gí-giân ū tsi̍t-kuá tê-bo̍k siōnn-beh tshì-khuànn-māi, hia tê-bo̍k lóng khah uá Gí-giân Luī-hîng-ha̍k (Linguistic Typology), m̄-sī Hîng-sik Gí-giân-ha̍k (Formal Linguistics). Lâm-tó gí-giân ê hîng-sik hun-sik ài án-nuá khui-thiah, guá put-lí-á tshenn-soo, ē-tàng kóng m̄-bat tshì--kuè.

2026-09-02

  • Tsa̍p-it--gue̍h tī Tiong-iong Gián-kiù-īnn pān--ê ILAS–NINJAL Joint Conference on Semantics, lāi-bīn ū kuí-phinn-á iàu-ì ê tê-bo̍k.

    Guá bo̍k-tsîng sī tuì Tâi-gí kù-huat ê gián-kiú khah si̍k-sāi, bē-tàng kóng sī si̍k-tshiú, m̄-koh ū-kuá king-giām. Hîng-sik Gí-ì-ha̍k (Formal Semantics) guá kàu-tann iáu sa bô tsáng-thâu, m̄-bat tsìng-king iōng-lâi tshú-lí Tâi-gí gí-liāu.

    • Yi-Hsun Chen, Mingming Liu / On the Modal Use of Mandarin ye

    • Jo-wang Lin / Sentence-final de in Mandarin Chinese: Propositional Assertion, Discourse Linking, and Aspectual Stability

    • Wei-wen Roger Liao, Chih-hsiang Shu / Beyond Change of State: A Scalar Semantics Analysis of Sentence-final LE in Chinese

    • Yen-Ju Lisa Chen, Hsiu-Chen Daphne Liao / Adjectival Compatibility in the Subject-Predication A-dao-NP Construction in Mandarin: Subjectivity, Scale Structure, and Context

2026-09-01

  • Khuànn-tio̍h Kong-sī Tâi-gí Sin-bûn 國家語言發展法欠拘束效果 民團討論立新法, tsit-khuán tōng-tsok guá kám-kak khah si̍t-tsāi.

    Ū-sî-tsūn ē khuànn-tio̍h ài tsìng-tī jîn-bu̍t tshiam-miâ liân-sú ê sin-bûn, bē-tàng kóng uân-tsuân bô ì-gī, m̄-koh tsāi-guá lâi-khuànn, kòo sim-tsiânn khah tsē-kuè tn̂g-kî ê huat-tián.

    • Chinfa Lien (National Tsing Hua University) / How Tshiann2 請 Emerges as a Politeness Particle

entry.title: 網站起鼓
entry.content:
最近想講來舞一 ê 網站，寫寡 khah 長 ê 文章。

這 ê 網站舊底（差不多十冬前）是用 html 寫--ê，成做個人 ê 網頁簡單仔用。Tiőng 有一段時間，Markdown 語法足 tshìng--ê，向時我 bat 揣看敢有家私頭通 kā Markdown 語法轉做 html，按呢網站資料 teh 翻新會 khah 利便。毋閣家私頭揣規晡，壟蓋夯枷，無我 ê 緣。雖罔我對 Markdown ê 語法蓋熟，但是誠 tsheh 電腦內面鬥一大堆有--ê 無--ê 軟體，落尾總--是貧惰，舊 ê 網站 tsőng-á 放--leh，無閣翻新。

這改趁機會用 Hexo + GitHub Action 做一遍改 hōo 好，我 ê 電腦紲--落來要意 Markdown 檔案就好，git push 了後，網站會自動翻新，免我操煩；上蓋重要 ê 是，我 ê 電腦猶原 iáu-sī 清氣相。抑若文章愛囥 tuà 佗一類、愛結佗一種牽仔（tag），thìng-hó 等我有閒 ê 時陣，才沓沓仔想。

網站號名叫做「Ngōo-giân-koh（悟言閣）」，意思就是用來寫一寡生活體驗、時勢管見，食老才知 ê 代。遮 ê 文章毋知影會當寫偌久，總--是一步一步照起工來，向望有一日，鴨卵會當抾到米斗 tīnn。
